description: Ponctualité des trains de marchandises - Stiptheid van de goederentreinen - Monthly freight trains punctuality is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Infrabel. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in CSV. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read).
